setup.text: The village well yields less water every morning.

choices.label: Seek a hidden spring with Nature knowledge.
Measure water use and repair leaks.
Hold a ceremony and ration fairly.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A patch of damp-loving plants reveals a nearby seep.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The plants indicate old moisture, not a usable spring.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Water rises briefly from a crack, raising new questions.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The spell fails, leaving the adept unsure why.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Careful records reveal a wasteful channel.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The repairs help, but drought continues.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Families quarrel over whether the ration is fair.
